title: Port of Los Angeles Container Congestion
description: Severe container backlog and dwell time at Port of Los Angeles due to rail carrier labor shortages and peak season volume.
response: Rerouted priority cargo via Oakland and Pacific Northwest ports; extended gate hours.
outcome: Dwell time reduced by 35% within 10 days; average delay mitigated from 7 days to 2 days.

title: Winter Storm Elliott Rail Freeze
description: Sub-zero temperatures and blizzard conditions halt Class 1 rail operations across Midwest and Northeast corridors.
response: Shifted time-sensitive freight to long-haul team truck drivers; staged heated warehouse storage.
outcome: Critical cold-chain goods preserved without spoilage; freight delivery delayed by 48 hours.

title: Panama Canal Drought Draft Restrictions
description: Historic low water levels at Gatun Lake force Panama Canal Authority to reduce daily vessel transit slots and maximum draft.
response: Booked transits 30 days in advance and shifted non-urgent container cargo to Suez Canal and Cape of Good Hope routes.
outcome: Increased transit time by 10-14 days but avoided unpredictable anchorage waiting times exceeding 21 days.

title: Rotterdam Port Cyberattack on Terminal Operating System
description: Ransomware outage disabled automated crane dispatch and gate appointment system at major container terminal.
response: Activated manual pen-and-paper gate checks and diverted feeder vessels to Antwerp.
outcome: Terminal restored within 72 hours; clearance backlogs cleared in 5 business days.

title: Historical Antwerp Berth Congestion
description: Vessel queue at Antwerp due to feeder ship bunching.
response: Rerouted non-urgent feeder traffic to Zeebrugge.
